title: Gun Seven: health 4.8k at 12.0k before Surge of Power vs spirit 4.8k at 11.2k first
question: At 12.0k souls, which state survives a gun duel longer and by how much does it lose damage?
hypothesis: H-N3: PROPOSED (Spirit Lifesteal+Enduring Speed) lives >= 20% longer vs a gun bot (HP 2166 vs 1694 calculated, plus 13% spirit lifesteal) and deals ~13% less window damage (5492 vs 6307).
controls: Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
Same souls/level per arm; ability tiers set with abil ops per FOUNDATIONS F9 (unlocked 1, T1 3, T2 7, T3 15), logged before each block
Same bot heroes, positions, HP keep-alive and resists
procedure: duel: cast 3, fire continuously; record time to death and damage dealt

decision.rule: HEALTH_FIRST >= +15% survival supports the proposed order; if damage loss > survival gain in kills-before-death, reopen
